description: ML-practical domain/intent taxonomy for a Razorpay-specific AI assistant.

intents.name: STATUS
intents.description: Check the current/status state of a Razorpay resource or transaction.

intents.name: FAILURE_TROUBLESHOOT
intents.description: Diagnose or troubleshoot a failed, declined, stuck, or unsuccessful Razorpay operation.

intents.name: MANAGEMENT
intents.description: General management, configuration, or account-level management when no more specific V1 intent applies.

intents.name: REFUND
intents.description: Request, initiate, or understand performing a refund.

intents.name: SETTLEMENTS
intents.description: Settlement-related operations, timing, configuration, or questions.

intents.name: PAYOUT_OPERATIONS
intents.description: Payout creation, status, failure, scheduling, or operational questions.

intents.name: TRANSFER_OPERATIONS
intents.description: Transfer-related operations and movement of funds between relevant Razorpay entities.

intents.name: COLLECTION_SETUP
intents.description: Create/configure collection mechanisms such as Payment Links, Pages, Buttons, QR Codes, and Smart Collect.

intents.name: BILLING_MANAGEMENT
intents.description: Invoices, subscriptions, and related billing-management operations.

intents.name: CHECKOUT_SDK_INTEGRATION
intents.description: Checkout setup, SDK integration, customization, and implementation questions.

intents.name: API_INTEGRATION
intents.description: General Razorpay API integration and implementation.

intents.name: API_ERROR_DEBUGGING
intents.description: Diagnose API authentication, request, response, HTTP error, or integration errors.

intents.name: WEBHOOK_INTEGRATION
intents.description: Webhook setup, events, delivery, signature verification, and debugging.

intents.name: FEES_PRICING
intents.description: Questions about Razorpay fees, pricing, charges, and applicable costs.

intents.name: INTERNATIONAL_PAYMENTS
intents.description: International payment acceptance, currencies, eligibility, and related configuration.

intents.name: ACCOUNT_KYC
intents.description: Account setup, verification, KYC, onboarding, and business-account issues.

intents.name: SECURITY_FRAUD
intents.description: Security, fraud prevention, suspicious activity, and risk-related questions.

intents.name: DISPUTES_CHARGEBACKS
intents.description: Disputes, chargebacks, representment, and related workflows.

intents.name: REPORTS_RECONCILIATION
intents.description: Reports, exports, reconciliation, and matching payment/settlement records.

intents.name: DOWNTIME_STATUS
intents.description: Razorpay availability, outages, incidents, and service status.

intents.name: GENERAL_RAZORPAY
intents.description: Razorpay-related informational questions that do not fit a more specific V1 intent.
